contributions.detail: ONE row on Form A, 500.00, equals cover line 1 THIS REPORT exactly. It does NOT equal the CUMULATIVE cell (12,066.20), so the row set is on the PERIOD scope — this is a summary report itemising only what has not been reported before, and the earlier 11,566.20 sits in the LAST-REPORT column un-itemised in this document. This is a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the cumulative figure the module publishes; that is honest and expected, and is why recon.scope is 'period'.
